product_flow.name: Toy electric trains and tracks, signals and other accessories therefor, reduced-size ("scale") model assembly kits and other construction sets and constructional toys

required_qualifiers: complete set configuration and required element counts
actual material/grade per element and make/buy state
complete supplied formulation and moisture
actual moulding/decoration/component assembly route
paper instruction inclusion and net-content boundary
explicit excluded electrical functions
supplier site and upstream boundary
unique first-release identity/time and actual acceptance specification/tests
calibrated complete net masses and packaging tare
raw/WIP/non-WIP inherited exchange vectors
actual wet stocks and gross physical events
packaging pools and upstream ownership
original-cohort Q_H and observed service horizon H
actual provider/native restrictions and unresolved identities
